patch.sql:
select
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount_rate as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount_rate) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The model stg_lineitem failed with a Binder Error: column "l_discount" not found. The raw.lineitem table has column "l_discount_rate" instead of "l_discount". This indicates a source column rename. According to policy, we patch the staging model to reference the new column name while preserving the contract. The net_revenue calculation is also updated to use the renamed column. The root cause is the upstream data change (renamed column).
